text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after marking a milestone in our
three years together in the Twinkle Series
with Gentildonna—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Using the voucher won at the raffle,
I came to the hot springs with Gentildonna.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I will leave everything in your hands today.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"You must have done
a lot of preparation, haven't you?"
choice_data_list: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. As my Trainer... you will let me rest plenty, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To give Gentildonna—who is stoic yet great at relaxing—a thorough rest...
At the time, I had set myself such a difficult challenge.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I wonder just how
you plan on refreshing me...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I shall assess you thoroughly.
choice_data_list: Ah—
Yeah—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...At that moment, it hit me.
Testing each other, showing off our power...
This is just like how we always do things.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If the goal is to refresh oneself,
isn't relaxing your shoulders the first prerequisite?
If so—
choice_data_list: Should we go to the hot springs first?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...Phew.
choice_data_list: (Ah, this might actually be good.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fresh out of the bath, Gentildonna's usual intimidating aura feels reduced by a third... no, maybe even by half... or so it seems.
choice_data_list: Glad you got the hot springs trip!
Glad you got the hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: That was a wonderfully soothing bath.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Normally, the only ryokan we stay at are ones where we've been invited by associates of our family, so...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Opportunities to visit unfamiliar places
are quite precious, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—If I let the people involved know,
maybe they'll owe me one.
choice_data_list: (...I ended up coming back for a bit.)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And? What is your
next strategy?
choice_data_list: Yeah... Let's head outside.
Yeah... Let's head outside.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Oh, it's gotten completely dark.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Options seem limited, though.
What are you going to do for me from here?
choice_data_list: …Can you relax your shoulders just a little more?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh my...
Are you trying to catch me off guard?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
And so, watching for an opening in my guard...
Are you aiming to strike me down as well, I wonder?
choice_data_list: Are you teasing me?
You're teasing me, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hohoho...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately,
I have never once thought about taking it easy.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
That is something other than me.
Or perhaps...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Are you trying to make me submit
by using brute force?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: With those slender arms.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A stinging, menacing aura is directed at me—
Just as I try to react on instinct... I notice something different from usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna is definitely projecting her aura this way—
though it's merely in jest...
choice_data_list: ...Ah, I think I can do it now.
...Yeah, feels like we could do it now.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bring my hands together in front of Gentildonna's face—
and give a light, sharp clap.
choice_data_list: Ei!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
choice_data_list: Haha, you let your guard down
Fufu, you let your guard down.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Because I never imagined
you'd do something so outrageous.
choice_data_list: Normally, my hand wouldn't have escaped unscathed.
Normally, my hand wouldn't have escaped unscathed.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well, there is a chance
I might have snapped it in half on reflex.
choice_data_list: Still, it didn't turn out that way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the moment she arrived today,
Gentildonna has been more relaxed than usual.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was because I had promised to "let her rest plenty"... Believing in those words, she was spending this very moment with me.
choice_data_list: You've shown the power of your trust.
You proved the power of your trust, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: "So that softens... my power."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that's still too naive.
choice_data_list: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment—Gentildonna
gently brought her lips to my ear...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —I win.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Gentildonna...
